about: P66 sealed set: 30 new English sentences written 2026-10-28 before any P66 code change. half new = 15 sentences aimed at the five new genres (3 each, genre = the aimed genre); half general = 15 sentences spread over the current genres (genre = classifyGenre(sentence, null) on main e661855c at sealing). Opened once in T16; nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: a space marine survives a swarm of alien beetles on a red planet while his blaster fires on its own
a viking fights off endless waves of trolls in a snowy forest and grows stronger after each wave
a garden gnome holds out against hordes of slugs crawling in from every side of the vegetable patch
a hole in the desert sand swallows cactuses, camels and tents, growing with every bite
a giant drain in a toy room sucks in blocks, dolls and in the end the whole toy box
an ever growing pit in a medieval town gulps carts, houses and finally the castle
a mouse steals cheese wheels from the cat's kitchen and drags them back to its hole
a bandit sneaks into the sheriff's office, grabs the bag of gold and rides it back to the hideout
a squirrel raids the neighbour's garden for nuts and stashes them in its tree while the dog chases it
sort the dirty laundry by colour into the right baskets
a florist arranges red, white and yellow roses into the matching vases
a robot at a recycling plant drops cans, bottles and paper into the right bins
tap the boats out of the crowded harbour, each one sails off only the way its bow points
free the sheep packed in the pen, a tapped sheep runs off the way it faces if nothing blocks it
clear the jammed train yard by tapping each wagon so it rolls out along its track
a cowboy shoots tin cans off a fence at sunset
a penguin slides down an icy mountain dodging rocks and snowmen
a monkey jumps from treetop to treetop to reach the golden banana at the top of the jungle
a hot air balloon flies over the mountains to reach the festival
a gardener waters all the thirsty flowers in the park before noon
throw paper balls into the trash can from across the office
build the tallest pancake tower in the diner
a frog drums to the beat in a swamp band
two knights face off in a duel on a narrow bridge
a little bird flaps between the pipes of an old factory
a kangaroo catches falling coconuts on a tropical beach
bonk the moles popping out of the golf course
slice the watermelons a farmer tosses into the air
a hedgehog crosses a busy highway at night
two crabs shove each other off a rock at low tide
